title: Pride Tandemaus
description: A combination data pack/resource pack that makes a slight change to the visual appearance of Tandemaus and Maushold.
body:
**Tandemaus Pride** is a combination datapack/resource pack that adds a slight visual change to both **Tandemaus** and **Maushold** within the Cobblemon mod. These changes are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay.

- **Both Tandemaus and Maushold** can now spawn with visually identical pairs. This change includes their base forms, two mice with pants, and two mice with shirts. 

This is my first published Cobblemon addon, and it is meant to support the LGBTQIA+ by promoting normalcy to same-sex couples and families. Happy Pride Month!

**Questions or Comments?**

Be sure to join Cobblemon's Discord and share your thoughts in "Ian's things" under the form channel named "content-zone-help"
